info.name: Master Z - Ip Man Legacy
info.plot: Dopo essere stato sconfitto dal maestro Ip Man, Cheung Tin Chi cerca di rifarsi una vita e insieme a suo figlio va ad Hong Kong, dove trova impiego come cameriere. Ma l'uomo sarà presto trascinato nuovamente nei guai dai membri della triade.

translations.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
translations.overview: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.
